definitions.explanation: In grammar, the case of the subject of a verb. In Japanese the nominative is marked by が (and, in some relative clauses, by の).

examples.japanese: {主格|しゅかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦の→の：09472_no⟧」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: The nominative が can change to の.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代名詞|だいめいし}→代名詞：11647_daimeishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{主格|しゅかく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{目的格|もくてきかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: English pronouns change form between the nominative and the objective case.

notes:
USAGE:
A grammar term. ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ marks the topic, not a case, so a phrase with ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ can be the subject without being in the {主格|しゅかく}. The '⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧→⟦の→の：09472_no⟧' change happens in noun-modifying clauses: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧{本|ほん} / ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧{本|ほん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{主語|しゅご}→主語：00377_shugo⟧: subject (the grammatical role)
- {目的格|もくてきかく}: objective case
- {所有格|しょゆうかく}: possessive case
